title: Hagalaz / SO(4) framed-sphere interlingua
summary: Current candidate formalization links recursive helix-to-superhelix framed spheres, UI readout, Three-Spheres composition and the six sphere-locked SO(4) coordinate-plane rotation channels. The compact rung-locked specialization has eight continuous channels: six rotations plus inter-order scale and normalized rung advance.
public_copy: A current solver-unification experiment asks whether one repeated framed-sphere operation can describe the jump from helix to superhelix and onward through higher orders. In a sphere-locked 4D frame there are six coordinate-plane rotation channels. Constraining center motion to the local rung/tangent direction adds one advance channel, while inter-order scale adds one more: an eight-channel candidate Hagalaz description. This is active sandbox formalization, not a settled theory definition.
